hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: Link clicks → Landing page views contributed -0.73 to ROAS (85% of all movement, adverse contributor).
hypotheses.unverified_business_cause: Landing page performance issues may have contributed to the lower link clicks → landing page views rate.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The exact reason for the drop is not known; it could be technical or relevance related.

hypotheses.mathematical_evidence: Checkout → Purchase contributed +0.05 to ROAS (6% of all movement, negligible).
hypotheses.unverified_business_cause: Recent checkout flow improvements may have contributed to the slight increase in the checkout → purchase conversion rate.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The improvement is small and may be incidental; further data is needed to confirm a causal link.

recommendations.investigation: Review landing page performance metrics for the current period.
recommendations.what_to_check: Page load time, server response time, and any recent page redesigns; a slowdown would support the hypothesis.
recommendations.expected_impact: If page performance degraded, fixing it should raise the link clicks → landing page views rate and improve ROAS.
recommendations.if_supported: Prioritize fixing page speed or revert recent changes, then monitor the metric.
recommendations.if_not_supported: Investigate other factors such as audience relevance or ad creative alignment.

recommendations.investigation: Examine recent changes to the checkout process.
recommendations.what_to_check: Implementation of new checkout steps, payment options, or UI tweaks; a positive change would explain the higher checkout → purchase rate.
recommendations.expected_impact: Confirming a beneficial change can guide replication across campaigns.
recommendations.if_supported: Document the effective change and apply it to other funnels.
recommendations.if_not_supported: Look for external factors (e.g., promotions) that might have driven the slight uplift.

additional_information.information: Detailed page speed logs and timestamps of any landing page redesigns.
additional_information.reason: To test whether technical performance caused the drop in link clicks → landing page views.

additional_information.information: Change log of checkout flow modifications and associated A/B test results.
additional_information.reason: To verify if recent checkout improvements are responsible for the modest positive contribution.

confidence_explanation: Both hypotheses rely on low‑level metrics that moved materially (link clicks → landing page views) or showed a small positive shift (checkout → purchase). Because the evidence does not directly identify a business cause, confidence remains low.
